implementationRevision: b492064 (feature/goz-0006-typed-manifests), after Phase 10 confirmation-review fixes (T092-T097). Demo 51 tests / 81 screenshots recorded by drive-speckit in evidence/demo-run.json; tests not re-run by the analyst. Re-analysed 2026-11-18 at df7916f after Phase 11 (T098 result status codes, T099 shared PostgreSQL rate limit).

findings.title: Manifest validation contract v1 facts every downstream spec builds on (endpoint, order, closed envelope v1, family/adapter matrix, result shape, projection v1, 11 categories and 40 rules, locations, bounds, determinism, statelessness)
evidence: src/Gozleme.Api/Manifests/ManifestContracts.cs: AcceptedResult/RejectedResult, ProblemLocation converter, ManifestJson deterministic serializer
progress.yaml decisions Q1-Q4, clarify Q1-Q4, P1-P4, problems-per-location, projection-map-order, deep-document-bound, results-overflow-catch
findings.recommendation: Record the contract facts in every dependent prompt; any change is a new envelope/projection/adapter/catalogue version.

findings.title: Pins, seed and demo after GOZ-0006: migration 20261120000000_ManifestValidationAttempts and table manifest_validation_attempts; renamed boundary test; 7 migrations; 18 scoped endpoints / 19 actions; product endpoints still 404; fixed seeded-demo publisher and manifest-demo capability; goz-0006 Playwright project
evidence: e2e/playwright.config.ts goz-0006 depends on goz-0005; e2e/tests/evidence.ts specDirs
findings.recommendation: Supersede the GOZ-0005 count; every new migration updates the new pin; GOZ-0007 narrows the table assertion.

findings.title: Telemetry, audit and limiter facts: span and counters, bounded outcomes incl. unavailable; no audit event so 1501-1510 still free; validation budget shared through PostgreSQL (gozleme.manifest_validation_attempts)
evidence: src/Gozleme.Api/Manifests/ManifestValidationLimiter.cs (PostgreSQL counter per account per clock minute)
findings.recommendation: Record names and the free audit range; GOZ-0005-IF-05 stays open only for the sign-in and invitation-redeem limits.

findings.title: Reserved vocabulary: manifests can never assert signatures, attestations, provenance, trust, approval, visibility, grants, ownership, lifecycle or revocation; these are registry-side records only; vocabulary change is a security review item
evidence: progress.yaml decisions Q4, reserved-matching, reserved-name-hardening, lookalike-*, reserved-closed-objects, reserved-dotted-names, native-deprecated-A1
findings.recommendation: State in each consumer that these claims are registry-side; a manifest-borne claim needs a maintainer decision.

findings.title: Secret detection is deterministic and best-effort: pattern list v1 (14 patterns) plus secret-bearing fields; joined-name check only for url-userinfo and azure-connection-secret; Bearer/Basic/Digest token split across member names is not detected (maintainer joined-names-patterns). Specs that persist, index, embed, export or federate manifest text inherit this residual risk
evidence: docs/specs/006-typed-manifests/contracts/secret-patterns.md 'auth-header is not checked on joined locations'
findings.recommendation: Maintainer decided: later specs search and embed projection fields only; raw native text stays stored and exportable as sent; indexing or embedding raw text needs its own decision. Written into the prompts.

findings.title: GOZ-0007 starts storage: reuse ManifestValidator, store native string verbatim with digest, record adapter and projectionVersion, own SemVer ordering/uniqueness, narrow the publish and no-table pins, attestations registry-side
findings.recommendation: Spec-specific alignment in GOZ-0007 with clarification questions (publish status for rejected, action name).

findings.title: Projection entry (kind, nativeName) uniqueness is enforced only by mcp/1; a2a/1 skill ids, api/1 operationIds (and derived METHOD path names) and event/1 keys across maps are not checked, which matters for child identity keys
findings.recommendation: Route to GOZ-0008 clarification: uniqueness rule and whether it is a new adapter version or a publish-time rule.

findings.title: Projection v1 has no digest; only the native digest exists. An extension-only change alters the native digest but not the projection. GOZ-0028 'projection digests' and GOZ-0022 materiality need a defined canonical form
evidence: ManifestContracts.cs NativeResult.Digest; ManifestProjection has no digest
findings.recommendation: Clarification question in GOZ-0007; consumers note it.

findings.title: Envelope v1 is closed and has no dependency/relationship/compatibility field; extension members are never projected
findings.recommendation: Clarification in GOZ-0024: registry-side API or new envelope/projection version; never read extension members.

findings.title: Identity check accepts only the local target canonical ID or alias; a foreign-origin claim is identity_mismatch, so re-validating imported manifests needs an origin-qualified target
findings.recommendation: Record in GOZ-0030; ties to GOZ-0005-IF-11.

findings.title: Reusable restricted YAML/JSON readers, RFC 6901 locations and fixed-message catalogue pattern; skill/1 does not enforce the name-equals-directory rule
findings.recommendation: Recommend reuse in GOZ-0018; route the directory rule to GOZ-0009 clarification.

findings.title: Declared content is advisory: MCP primitive lists are publisher-declared, A2A provider never the owner, nothing is executed
findings.recommendation: Record in consumers; trusted facts and playground never treat declarations as verified.

findings.title: Disclosed GOZ-0006 agent choices that were offered for veto but never explicitly ratified by the maintainer become permanent stored data once GOZ-0007 persists manifests: secretref:<provider>/<key> form (A2), 200 for rejected (A3), markdown encoding value, lifecycle claims reserved, manifest.validate on the capability resource, in-memory per-instance limiter, unavailable outcome, missing-member location, YAML .inf/.nan kept as strings, A2A required overlay, _meta on MCP serverInfo
evidence: docs/specs/006-typed-manifests/progress.yaml agentChoices (each 'disclosed to the maintainer for veto')
findings.recommendation: Maintainer decided: 10 choices ratified as built; A3 replaced by result-status-codes; in-memory limit replaced by shared-rate-limit; manifest.validate stays on capability and GOZ-0007 introduces a manifest resource type. Written into the prompts.

findings.title: Process: Corvus.Text.Json analyzer loads only in container/CI restore; CTJ analyzers removed in Directory.Build.targets; schema digests pinned; validation reuses PublisherStore lookups without reading alias_reservations
Search and embeddings should use projection fields; never-projected native text (extensions, examples, URLs, bodies) must not be indexed or embedded by default
findings.recommendation: Default recorded; indexing native text beyond the projection is a clarification/security question.
